events.title: George Balanchine's The Nutcracker
events.venue: David H. Koch Theater, Lincoln Center
events.addr: 20 Lincoln Center Plaza, New York, NY 10023
events.blurb: New York City Ballet's holiday classic opens its run Thanksgiving weekend, with the famous growing tree and live orchestra.

events.title: Macy's Santaland
events.blurb: Walk through the eighth-floor winter village to visit Santa. Lines are long on Black Friday; go early.

events.title: Bluey's Aussie Christmas
events.blurb: A Bluey-themed holiday stop at The Shops at Hudson Yards. Santa photos are on Level 3 from 5 p.m.

events.title: Winter Village at Bryant Park
events.addr: 6th Ave & W 42nd St, New York, NY 10018
events.blurb: Holiday shops, food kiosks and a free-admission skating rink in Midtown. Skate rental and reserved skate times cost extra.

events.title: The Rink at Rockefeller Center
events.blurb: Skate under the giant tree (it's lit the following week). Book a timed session online ahead of the holiday rush.

events.title: Dyker Heights Christmas Lights
events.blurb: Brooklyn's famous over-the-top house displays go up the day after Thanksgiving. Best after dark; take the D to 79th St.

events.title: Big Apple Circus
events.addr: 1st Ave & E 96th St, New York, NY 10029
events.blurb: The one-ring circus returns to its tent on the Upper East Side for the holiday season.

events.title: Hibernation Hike in Pelham Bay Park
events.blurb: Urban Park Rangers lead an hour-long walk looking at how animals get ready for winter.

events.title: Small Business Saturday Tree Lighting
events.blurb: Park Slope's tree lighting with hot chocolate and a visit from Santa.

events.title: A Charlie Brown Christmas
events.venue: Lehman Center for the Performing Arts
events.addr: 250 Bedford Park Blvd W, Bronx, NY 10468
events.blurb: The Peanuts gang's holiday special, live on stage.

events.title: NBA Cup: Knicks vs. Miami Heat
events.blurb: A Black Friday NBA Cup group-stage game at the Garden.
